findings.impact: Design §4.10 asks for a data-updated time; current text is an honest placeholder, no incorrect value is shown.
findings.suggested_fix: Wire a real sampling/ledger timestamp when the member contract exposes it; until then keep the honest placeholder.

findings.impact: Raw state codes like 'succeeded' rendered verbatim while the rest of the page uses Chinese StatusBadge; readability/consistency only.
findings.suggested_fix: Reuse StatusBadge or the existing label map; do not change count semantics.

findings.impact: Editable reason is part of the scope digest, so changing it after preview forces one extra read-only preview (more conservative than server PREVIEW_STALE; no unsafe submit).
findings.suggested_fix: If reason is not part of server-side conclusion/digest, exclude it after confirming with backend contract.
